setting.help: The AI service answering new conversations. Leave empty to use the first provider that is ready.

div.div: A provider for the work, if you want one: a free model on your own server for the questions, a stronger one for what Nudge does and builds.

setting.help: Before a question goes to an AI provider that does not run on your own server, emails, phone numbers, IBANs, Emirates ID, Saudi and Egyptian national numbers and card numbers become tokens such as EMAIL_1. The answer and the confirmation cards get the real values back here. It reduces what leaves; a number written in an unusual way can be missed. Off by default.

field.name: nudge_redact_sample
field.placeholder: Type a text to see what would be masked

setting.help: The only hosts Nudge may send to: AI providers, connectors, the recipe marketplace, the search model download and the compliance feed. One per line, for example api.anthropic.com, localhost:11434 or *.example.com. Empty: no restriction. Any other host is refused before the request.

div.div: Choose "Only the list" for sensitive environments: with an empty list, only the AI providers you configured are reached.

setting.help: Nothing is sent to an AI provider that does not run on your own server (tick it on the provider). Quick search, the slash commands, the recorded tours, the explanations that need no AI, remembered answers and providers on your own server keep working. A lock shows in the panel.
setting.div: A provider on your own server listens to the voice. Without one, voice stays off.

div.div: Lets the speech of the browser be used when no provider on your own server listens, for talking, dictating and reading answers aloud. Chrome and Edge may send the sound to their maker, and Nudge cannot prevent it. Off by default.

Lets the marketplace read recipe indexes and download recipe files (HTTPS only, each file checked against its index). It is not an AI call, but the site that hosts the index sees the address of this server. Off by default.

setting.help: Conversations whose last activity is older than this number of days are deleted every day, with their messages, screens and images. One in which the Agent acted is archived instead: the log of what it did is kept. One that is answering, or waits for a yes, is left. 0 keeps them for ever.
People can let Nudge see the screen they are on. The record, its fields and their values are then sent to the AI provider with the question. Nothing is sent in the background.
People can talk to Nudge and dictate in the fields of Odoo. The microphone is open only while they hold the shortcut or after they pressed the button. No recording is kept.

div.div: Chrome, Edge and Safari send the sound to the servers of their maker. The AI provider receives it where it receives the questions.

setting.help: Choose how Nudge answers (rules only, a local model or a cloud provider), see what it would cost each month, set the budgets and switch it on. It works before any provider exists, and ends with rules only if you want no AI. A key typed there is kept on the provider, where only system administrators read it.

button.name: %(nudge.nudge_setup_wizard_action)d
button.string: Choose a provider and see the cost

setting.help: Nudge asks for the company, its country, currency, languages, apps, warehouses and users, one step at a time, and shows a card with the exact changes before each one. Nothing is done before your yes; most steps can be undone. The fiscal localisation module is named on its card. The outgoing mail server is never configured by Nudge.

button.name: action_nudge_setup
button.string: Set up this database with me

setting.help: The health check and the tasks of the kind Outliers look for payslips, bills, invoices, stock moves, expenses, discounts, purchase prices and attendance far from the usual of their group. No AI is used; only what the person may read is looked at.

A small strip under the title of a form warns about a mistake while the person fills it in, before they save. Nothing is blocked: the person decides. No AI is used, except when someone clicks Ask Nudge about this. Each person can mute a warning for themselves.
On a phone, the panel opens full screen with these big tiles for people in the field. They are chosen for each company. A tile of an app that is not installed is not shown.

Every Nudge User can ask Nudge about the data in Talk: how many, how much, which most, a chart. Nudge reads with the rights and the record rules of the person, in their companies, and never creates or changes anything: the tools that do are not offered to it. Every answer says the filter it was worked out on, with a link to the list.

People of the group Agent User can ask Nudge to do the work: look up records, create and change them, press buttons. Nudge acts with the rights of the person, shows what it is about to do, and waits for their yes before each change. It never deletes.

div.div: What Nudge reads of the records goes to the AI provider with the question.

setting.help: Many records with one yes: the same change or the same button on many records, or a few steps on the same records. Nudge tries the plan first and undoes it, shows how many records go through and why the others do not; beyond 20 records it is done in the background. What it wrote can be undone; what a button did cannot.

Tasks Nudge does by itself, on a schedule or when records appear: "every morning, the overdue invoices". As their owner, reading only: a change a task finds needed waits for the owner's yes. The records are counted first: when nothing matches, the AI is not asked. Each run counts in the budgets.

Let the agent compute with Python when counting and searching are not enough: a loop over records, a calculation per record. The code runs in the sandbox of Odoo, as the person, and reads only: what it writes is discarded, and changes still go through the yes of the person. Every run is in What Nudge Did. Off by default.

Let administrators read the database with one SELECT through the agent, for a join or a report no other tool gives. Only the group Settings, and only those allowed in every company: a query knows no company rule. No change, no lock, no comment; the tables of Odoo they may read, never those of users, parameters or providers; 50 rows, 10 seconds. Every query is in What Nudge Did. Off by default.

Let administrators read and change the setup of Odoo through the agent: users, groups and privileges, companies, menus, views, actions, scheduled actions, system parameters, as Settings and Technical show them. Only the group Settings. As the person, one confirmation per change, never a deletion; passwords, keys and tokens stay hidden, and SQL keeps away from those tables. Off by default.

Let administrators build through Nudge, in Developer mode: automation rules, server actions, emails sent on an event, buttons, fields and changes to the screens. Only the group Settings. Nudge explains first and shows everything on the card, the code included; nothing is made before a yes; deletion only when asked for by name. Every step is in What Nudge Did. Off by default.
The official documentation of Odoo, every app, which Nudge searches to say how standard Odoo works. It comes with the module: nothing is fetched from outside.

Open a screen, find a record, filter a list, count, create, change a field or press a button are understood by rules, in Arabic and English, without calling the AI provider: no token is spent, and every change still waits for a yes. What is not understood goes to the AI as before.

A small model (multilingual-e5-small, about 135 MB in the filestore, downloaded from https://huggingface.co/Xenova/multilingual-e5-small) that runs on the CPU of this server. It re-ranks the documentation, the company files and the remembered answers by meaning, and finds an English page for a question in Arabic. No AI provider is involved and nothing leaves the server, so private mode does not stop it. It needs the Python packages onnxruntime and tokenizers. Not covered: the records of other models. Memory: while it is loaded, each Odoo process that answered a question holds about 450 MB (the model and its vocabulary), and the process that indexes about 600 MB; plan 0.5 GB per worker that serves searches. The model is loaded at the first question, shared by all the databases of a process, and dropped after the idle time below.

button.name: action_nudge_embedding_remove
button.confirm: Delete the model files and the vectors?

setting.help: After this many questions the older ones are replaced, in what Nudge reads, by a short summary that the person can read and correct in the conversation. Fewer tokens for every later question; the messages stay in the panel. 0 keeps the whole history.

A thumbs-up on an explanation keeps it for a manager to approve; an approved answer then answers the same question of the others at once, without the AI provider and without cost. Nothing that changed data or showed values of the database is kept.

Nudge counts how often the same question is asked, in any dialect, without keeping who asked, and proposes to the managers the ones that have no remembered answer and no tour. No AI provider is called.
What Nudge may spend at the AI provider, counted in tokens and in the prices set on the provider. 0 is no limit. Past a limit, Nudge answers that it must wait.

One answer holds one worker of the server while it streams; a few at once leave none for the screens of everyone else. 0 is automatic: the workers of the server less two, at least one. Past the limit, the next questions wait in line and start as soon as an answer ends; the person sees their place and can cancel. Work in the background does not count.

Calls to the AI provider older than this many whole months are removed from the usage list every day, a batch at a time. The current month is always kept, so budgets read the same totals. 0 keeps everything.

When Nudge answers as many people as it may at once, the next questions wait in line instead of being refused: the person sees their place and about how long, and can cancel. Their answer starts as soon as one ends. A provider may also take fewer at once (Answers at Once, on the provider; one for Ollama).

A provider that answers in place of the usual one, once, when it fails or has no key; when the budget of a person is used up, if it runs on your own server (it costs nothing); and always in private mode, if it runs on your own server. Each answer it gives says so. Nothing is sent to a provider you did not choose here or above.

A card in the panel shows a new person (in their first 14 days, or put in training by a manager) how many of the key screens of their role they opened and the tours left to take. No AI is used and only the screens opened are kept. Switched off, nobody is followed.

The weekly health check of this company runs as this Nudge manager and looks at what they may read. Empty: no weekly check. The check, the compliance checklists (a checklist, not legal advice) and the check before an upgrade are run by a manager from Nudge, Health Check; none of them uses AI or changes anything.

Each person has a page with the numbers of the apps they may use, with the trend against last week and Show me. It is counted as the person every five minutes, with no AI, and is there for everyone who has Nudge.

A recording attached or made in the panel is summarised and then forgotten: the file is removed within one hour. The transcript is kept nowhere. Needs a provider that accepts audio, and ffmpeg on the server for voice notes.

In Developer mode an administrator can ask for a whole Odoo module for 17, 18 or 19. It is shown as a spec card first, checked in memory and given as a ZIP; nothing is installed or written on the server.
Translate a module into any language with the AI, review every term, then write them into the database and download the .po file.
Give Nudge to every internal user. Otherwise, add people to the Nudge groups one by one.

Country checklists can be updated from a feed signed by its publisher. It is off while the address or the key is empty. Nudge then fetches one small file a day from that address only, checks its signature with the key below, and shows what would change: nothing is replaced until a system administrator approves it. The checklists that come with Nudge stay the fallback.

A cheaper model answers the light work: questions in Talk, which change nothing, summaries, explanations and short texts. Set one on each provider (a cheaper model of the same provider, such as Claude Haiku beside Sonnet, a mini model beside the full one, Flash beside Pro), or choose here another provider for those that have none. The provider of the conversation answers what acts or builds, what is marked heavy, and once more what the cheaper model failed at. Latency and Cost shows the answers of each and about what was saved.
